text: Jayco acquired the motorhome rental company Around Australia Motorhomes and rebranded it as Let's Go Motorhomes, a 2017 press release announced; Let's Go Motorhomes' own site still says it is proudly backed by Jayco, Australia's largest manufacturer of recreational vehicles.

source.name: 24-7PressRelease: Australian Recreational Vehicle Leader Jayco Announces Expansion Into RV Rental Market With Newly Acquired Let's Go Motorhomes
source.quote: they recently acquired Around Australia Motorhomes, who have a reputation as Australia's premium motorhome rental service. Jayco has rebranded Australia Motorhomes as Let's Go Motorhomes
source.note: Press release distributed by Let's Go Motorhomes (its own contact details at the foot). The release spells the acquired company both 'Around Australia Motorhomes' and 'Australia Motorhomes'.

additionalSources.name: Let's Go Motorhomes: About Us
additionalSources.quote: We are proudly backed by Jayco, Australia’s largest manufacturer of recreational vehicles, giving us access to their extensive dealer network
